title: v0.4 Resource Pack Restructure Plan
evidenceBase: EVAL-8: Factory Lite core is the winner. Resource pack should reflect default Factory Lite structure.
note: This is a PLAN only. No files are being moved or created. Implementation requires user confirmation in FACTORY-V04-PREP.

core.purpose: Always-active Factory Lite Core. Loaded every session.
contents: core/evidence-hierarchy.md — Process vs product evidence separation
core.expectedUserPath: Loaded at session start for all Factory-assisted projects
core.risk: Core must stay small. If it grows >10 pages, it becomes noise.

starters.purpose: Project starter templates for common project types
starters.expectedUserPath: Matched by APP_TYPE_ROUTER.md after project classification
starters.risk: Templates may become outdated. Review quarterly.

blueprints.expectedUserPath: Referenced during Architect phase of 3-role model

skills.purpose: Reusable skill modules for common concerns
skills.expectedUserPath: Selected by Manual Router based on project needs
skills.risk: Skill granularity is good. Do not fragment further.

roles.purpose: Optional 3-role model definitions. Only loaded when user opts in.
roles.expectedUserPath: Loaded only when 3-role model is activated (Tier 1 escalation)
roles.risk: If roles/ is always loaded, it defeats the purpose of conditional activation.

benchmarks.purpose: Benchmark specs, evaluation harness, and historical results
benchmarks.expectedUserPath: Used for benchmark evaluation contexts only

archive.purpose: Deprecated or deferred mechanisms preserved for reference
contents: context-os/ — Full Agent OS event bus design
archive.expectedUserPath: Reference only. Not loaded by default.
archive.risk: Archive must not be accidentally loaded. Clearly marked as deprecated/deferred.

migrationActions.action: Identify core files for core/ directory
Simplify Manual Router to remove role-company references
Update GLOBAL_CODEX_RULES.md to reference v0.4 defaults
Remove auto-activation of role model from constitution

doNotCreate: No files are being created or moved during EVAL-9. This is a PLAN only. Implementation awaits user confirmation in FACTORY-V04-PREP.
